title: 游戏内容不完整且缺乏打磨
description: 游戏在未完成状态下发布，存在大量未实现或半成品系统、bug、粗糙之处和卡顿问题，与全价独立游戏定位不符。
evidence: Of course there are some bugs and some jank.

evidence_items.quote: they rushed it to 1.0 when its clearly no where near release
evidence_items.description: 游戏在远未完成的状态下就发布了1.0版本。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们把它仓促推到了1.0，而它显然还远未达到发布状态

evidence_items.quote: There is some unimplented features or half made ones that brings the game down allot
evidence_items.description: 游戏中有未实现或半成品的功能，拖累了游戏。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一些未实现或半成品的功能，大大拖累了游戏

evidence_items.quote: It could use alot of polish
evidence_items.description: 游戏缺乏打磨
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它需要大量的打磨

evidence_items.quote: still have ton of trouble
evidence_items.description: 游戏仍有大量问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 仍然有一大堆麻烦

evidence_items.quote: It's not even a 1.0 game, there's a lot of things to polish and add, bug squashing and QoL.
evidence_items.description: 游戏未完成，缺乏打磨和内容
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这甚至都算不上一个1.0版本的游戏，还有很多东西需要打磨和添加，修bug和改善生活质量。

evidence_items.quote: It also feels incomplete
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容不完整
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它也让人感觉不完整

evidence_items.quote: A bit buggy
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在一些bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有点小毛病

evidence_items.quote: this doesn't look like it's at 1.0 state
evidence_items.description: 游戏未达到1.0完成度
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这看起来不像是1.0的状态

evidence_items.quote: They're rushing a game with incredible potential instead of letting them cook
evidence_items.description: 游戏被仓促开发，未让开发者充分打磨
evidence_items.quote_zh: 他们在一款潜力惊人的游戏上赶工，而不是让它慢慢打磨

evidence_items.quote: muy bugueado
evidence_items.description: 游戏仍然有很多bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: bug很多

evidence_items.quote: There's some jankiness with the game currently.
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在卡顿不流畅的问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前游戏存在一些粗糙卡顿的问题。

evidence_items.quote: A lot of the in-game quests are broken
evidence_items.description: 大量游戏内任务损坏无法正常完成
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏中的许多任务都是坏的

evidence_items.quote: the recent updates have fixed a good amount of jank
evidence_items.description: 近期更新修复了大量卡顿/粗糙问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 最近的更新修复了不少粗糙之处

evidence_items.quote: noticeable amount of bugs though
evidence_items.description: 存在明显数量的bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不过bug数量明显不少

evidence_items.quote: there are still bugs and issues
evidence_items.description: 游戏仍存在bug和问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 仍然有bug和问题

evidence_items.quote: it is janky
evidence_items.description: 游戏整体有卡顿、不流畅的问题
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它很粗糙

evidence_items.quote: It can be a little janky at times
evidence_items.description: 游戏有时略显粗糙卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它有时会有点卡顿不稳

evidence_items.quote: Still very buggy experience in 2025 i spend a lot of time trying to resolve workarounds.
evidence_items.description: 2025年仍存在大量bug，需要花时间绕过
evidence_items.quote_zh: 到了2025年仍然是bug满满的体验，我花大量时间试图找到变通办法。

evidence_items.quote: some small bugs that you can stop yourself
evidence_items.description: 存在一些小bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有一些小bug，你可以自己避免

evidence_items.quote: Of course there are some bugs and some jank.
evidence_items.description: 存在一些bug和粗糙之处
evidence_items.quote_zh: 当然，也有一些bug和一些粗糙之处。

evidence_items.quote: Careening off into space at 1 km/s after the police try to dock and board me, only to send me flying off
evidence_items.description: 警察试图对接登船时玩家被弹飞
evidence_items.quote_zh: 警察试图停靠并登船时，我却以1公里/秒的速度飞向太空，结果只是把我甩飞出去

evidence_items.quote: has cubic tons of bugs
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在大量bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有海量的bug

evidence_items.quote: They need to clean up some clock tick lowering bugs atm though.
evidence_items.description: 时钟滴答声降低相关的bug需要清理
evidence_items.quote_zh: 不过他们目前需要清理一些降低时钟滴答的bug。

evidence_items.quote: would expect quite a bit more polish for a "full indie game" sticker price
evidence_items.description: 游戏打磨不足，与全价独立游戏定位不符
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对于一款“完整独立游戏”的标价，我会期望打磨程度要高得多。

evidence_items.quote: There are too many unfinished systems to have a really good gaming experience in its current state.
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在过多未完成的系统，当前状态体验不佳
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有太多未完成的系统，以目前的状态无法获得真正良好的游戏体验。

evidence_items.quote: Currently there isn't much of a game here, and what is there is very, very broken.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容极少且非常破碎，处于早期alpha阶段
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前这里算不上有多少游戏内容，而现有的那点东西也非常、非常地坏掉了。

evidence_items.quote: Ostranauts spielt sich an allen Ecken hakelig und nicht rund.
evidence_items.description: 游戏在各个角落都显得笨拙、不流畅。
evidence_items.quote_zh: Ostranauts玩起来处处都磕磕绊绊，一点也不流畅。

evidence_items.quote: still a little bare bones and buggy here and there
evidence_items.description: 游戏仍有些bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 仍然有点简陋，而且这里那里都有bug

evidence_items.quote: It's too unfinished, rough and not intuitive
evidence_items.description: 游戏太不完整、粗糙且不直观
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它太未完成、粗糙且不直观

evidence_items.quote: I am nearing the asteroid OKLG when suddenly "error" begins to repeat on loop.
evidence_items.description: 接近OKLG小行星时出现循环报错
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我正接近小行星OKLG，这时突然“错误”开始循环重复。

evidence_items.quote: The game is a buggy mess on alot of fronts right now
evidence_items.description: 游戏目前存在大量bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这个游戏目前在很多方面都是一团糟的bug

evidence_items.quote: Absolutely unplayable and not understandable for now
evidence_items.description: 游戏目前无法正常游玩且难以理解
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前完全没法玩，也完全看不懂

evidence_items.quote: with each update it just gets worse
evidence_items.description: 每次更新后游戏变得更糟
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次更新都只会变得更糟

evidence_items.quote: 今は、アーリーアクセスの段階で、十分なプレイができないので
evidence_items.description: 处于抢先体验阶段，内容不足，无法充分游玩
evidence_items.quote_zh: 现在处于抢先体验阶段，还不能充分游玩，所以

evidence_items.quote: Очень сырая. Сейчас брать нельзя
evidence_items.description: 游戏非常不成熟，目前不建议购买
evidence_items.quote_zh: 非常不成熟。现在不能买

evidence_items.quote: right now the game is in rough shape
evidence_items.description: 游戏目前处于粗糙状态
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前游戏的状态很粗糙

evidence_items.quote: there are bugs that make playing it slightly harder
evidence_items.description: 存在使游玩稍显困难的bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些bug会让游玩变得稍微困难一些

evidence_items.quote: The biggest issue that I have with this game is how buggy it is
evidence_items.description: 游戏bug很多
evidence_items.quote_zh: 我对这款游戏最大的意见就是它漏洞太多了

evidence_items.quote: plenty of bugs
evidence_items.description: 存在大量bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大量的bug

evidence_items.quote: This game is extremely early access, expect lots of bugs
evidence_items.description: 游戏处于极早期阶段，存在大量bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 这款游戏处于极度早期的抢先体验阶段，预计会有大量bug

evidence_items.quote: Has like 5% of features implemented. Maybe even less.
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容不完整，仅实现了约5%的功能
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大概只实现了5%的功能。也许还更少。

evidence_items.quote: the game is buggy and that is still a bit rough around the edges
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在bug且粗糙。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏有bug，而且仍然有点粗糙

evidence_items.quote: bugs and confusion abound
evidence_items.description: 游戏存在bug且令人困惑。
evidence_items.quote_zh: bug和困惑比比皆是

evidence_items.quote: Lots of forthcoming features are not implemented yet.
evidence_items.description: 许多计划中的功能尚未实现。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 许多即将推出的功能尚未实现。

evidence_items.description: 存在大量bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 大量的bug

evidence_items.description: 存在使游玩稍显困难的bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 有些bug会让游玩变得稍微困难一些

evidence_items.quote: still a little bare bones and buggy here and there
evidence_items.description: 游戏仍有些bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: 仍然有点简陋，而且这里那里都有bug

evidence_items.quote: muy bugueado
evidence_items.description: 游戏仍然有很多bug
evidence_items.quote_zh: bug很多

evidence_items.quote: It also feels incomplete
evidence_items.description: 游戏内容不完整
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它也让人感觉不完整

evidence_items.quote_zh: 大概只实现了5%的功能。也许还更少。
